description: This source file defines the code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard page in an Online Examination System. It contains event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, and a search feature, with parts of the database interaction code commented out.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard WebForm, handling page events and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Contains commented-out code for fetching data from the database on initial load.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the 'home' button, navigating to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the 'profile' button, navigating to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles the search button click; contains commented code for database query and updates the session with the selected semester.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click, transferring the user to the LoginPage.
